'''2003 North American Continental Championship''' was the Star Wars CCG North American Continental Championships, held by the [[Players Committee]] at [[Gen Con 2003]] in Indianapolis on Saturday 26 July 2003.<ref name="pc-gencon03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Events/gencon05282003.htm SWCCG Player's Committee @ Gen Con 2003], swccgpc.com (28 May 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030713191047/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/gencon05282003.htm Internet Archive]</ref> The new North American Champion was to win a paid trip to the [[2003 World Championship|2003 World Championships]] at Dragon*Con.<ref name="pc-gencon03" />

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Gen Con, Indianapolis, Indiana
* '''Dates:''' 26 July 2003<ref name="pc-gencon03" />
* '''Venue:''' Indiana Convention Center, 100 South Capitol Avenue, Indianapolis<ref name="pc-gencon03" />
* '''Time:''' 10am<ref name="pc-gencon03" />
* '''Fee:''' $10<ref name="pc-gencon03" />
* '''Structure:''' six games of Swiss (eight if more than 32 players), then a final confrontation between the top two players<ref name="pc-gencon03" />

== Prizes ==

The champion was to receive paid airfare for a trip to the World Championships at Dragon*Con 2003, up to $300 and subject to approval by the Player Advocates; the winner had to attend and play in the 2003 World Championships. The event awarded two byes into Day 2 of Worlds, and 2nd place had the opportunity to create a virtual card. Star Wars CCG product, foils and uncut sheets were also among the prizes.<ref name="pc-gencon03" /> At the 2003 World Championships, players qualified from Continentals were among those eligible for Day 2.<ref name="pc-dragoncon03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Events/dragoncon08092003.htm SWCCG Player's Committee @ Dragon*Con 2003: The World Championships], swccgpc.com (9 August 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20031011001242/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/dragoncon08092003.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
